heading: Crowns and bridges: questions.
items: How long does a crown last?
Cared for properly, fifteen years or more.
In the practice's own lab, with the fit and color checked against the teeth on either side before the crown is seated.
Bridge or implant: which is better?
A bridge is the next best option if you are not ready for an implant. A bridge can also be anchored to implants instead of natural teeth, which avoids reshaping two healthy neighbors to carry it.
The front desk checks your insurance before you come in. The cost turns on how many teeth are treated and the material, and both are settled at the consultation, in writing.
Where can I get a crown in McLean or Alexandria?
